data.title: Story Bridge
data.description: Compare characters, settings, events, and big ideas across two illustrated stories.

stories.title: Sharing On The Farm
stories.opening: Morning came to the big green farm.
stories.closing: Everyone felt happy and shared all day long.
stories.mainIdea: Friends on the farm shared their food and toys to have fun together.

characters.name: Pig
characters.sentence: Pig shared a yummy apple by the red barn.
characters.uniqueDetail: ate a crunchy red apple near the big barn

characters.name: Cow
characters.sentence: Cow shared a red wagon on the dirt path.
characters.uniqueDetail: pulled a heavy red wagon across the dirt

characters.name: Duck
characters.sentence: Duck shared a shiny blue ball near the fence.
characters.uniqueDetail: bounced a shiny blue ball near the wooden fence

stories.title: Sharing In The Garden
stories.opening: Morning came to the pretty flower garden.
stories.closing: Everyone felt glad and shared until bedtime.
stories.mainIdea: Friends in the garden shared their snacks and games to have fun together.

characters.name: Bunny
characters.sentence: Bunny shared a yummy apple by the tall flowers.
characters.uniqueDetail: ate a crisp green apple near the tall flowers

characters.name: Bear
characters.sentence: Bear shared a red wagon on the soft grass.
characters.uniqueDetail: pushed a rolling red wagon across the grass

characters.name: Frog
characters.sentence: Frog shared a shiny blue ball near the pond.
characters.uniqueDetail: tossed a shiny blue ball near the water pond

challenges.comparisonSummary: Bunny and Pig both shared a yummy apple.
Cow and Bear both shared a red wagon.
Frog and Duck both shared a shiny blue ball.
